verdict.rationale: The only freshness evidence is that MX automatically aggregates each member about every 24 hours. That is a recurring background schedule, not a developer-triggered on-demand refresh through the API. Nothing in the pack documents an API call that triggers a refresh or explains its semantics.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trigger an on-demand refresh of a connected account's data through the API when my use case needs now-fresh data, with the refresh semantics documented

citations.quote: MX automatically aggregates each `member` approximately every 24 hours.
